text:
maya: Quick UX review — new 'Tool Output Inspector' mock in the playground. Focus: structured output, keyboard nav, and copy for function calls. Posting notes and quick suggestions.

tom: Nice, thanks. Can you attach the Figma? I skimmed earlier but want the panel flow.

maya: https://figma.com/file/xyz — main things: left is call list, middle is inspector (rendered card + raw JSON toggle), right is run metadata. Also persistent 'rerun with inputs' CTA.

alex: First impression: the rendered card is great but we need clear affordances for when the tool output doesn't match the schema. Right now the red badge is pretty small.

jordan: Accessibility nit: tabbable order seems off in the proto — you should be able to tab from the call list -> inspector -> rerun -> back to call list. Also focus trap when the inspector is open.

luis: Copy nits: 'Rerun with inputs' feels long. Maybe 'Rerun' and a secondary 'Edit inputs' link? Also 'Schema mismatch' -> 'Output didn't match schema' is more user-friendly.

maya: Agree on copy. Also let's add a subtle timestamp + model/variant line under the call header (small text) so people can scan for regressions.

alex: Question about raw JSON toggle: should it preserve collapsed keys state between runs? I think yes. Devs often expand the same fields every time.

tom: Implementation detail — if we persist collapse state, tie it to the tool signature + run id. Otherwise it gets messy when schema changes.

playground-bot: [automated note] New run 0c9a2b finished. tool: weather_lookup. status: tool-failed. logs available.

jordan: For failures, show a short collapsible trace and a 'Copy error' button. Make sure the button has aria-label="Copy error message".

luis: Keyboard shortcuts proposal: 'i' to open inspector for selected call, 'e' to edit inputs inline, 'r' to rerun. Need to add an a11y help modal.

maya: Love the shortcuts. Also we discussed an inline schema hint: small "expected: {city:string, units:enum}" chip under outputs. Click to open schema editor. Any objections?

alex: No objections. One more thing — the rerun flow should surface the diff between prev inputs and current defaults. Even a 1-line summary: "changed city: 'SF' -> 'Oakland'".

tom: UX question: where does run history live? Current mock hides older runs behind a 'See more' that scrolls. I'd prefer a paginated list with filtering by tool name and status.

maya: Ok action items:
- tweak copy: 'Rerun' + 'Edit inputs' link (luis)
- improve a11y: tab order & aria labels + help modal (jordan)
- persist JSON collapse state per (tool sig + run id) (tom)
- schema hint chip that links to editor (alex)
- diff preview on rerun (alex)
- run history: add filter bar + pagination (maya)

luis: I'll draft the copy and small microcopy doc and drop it here tomorrow.

alex: I can try a small prototype for the diff preview — should be quick with the existing diff util.

jordan: I'll prototype the keyboard modal and a11y checklist.

maya: Thanks team. If no blockers I'll push an updated figma by EOD and tag @design for quick pass.

playground-bot: [deploy] playground-preview updated: rpn-1223 (maya). View: https://play.redwood.dev/rpn-1223

tom: Quick note — make sure the inspector's contrast passes AA for the small timestamp text. It looked light in the figma.

maya: Good catch. I'll bump it. Close enough for this thread, will follow up in the figma comments. :thumbsup:
